minutes.headline: Commission extended the Lake Shirley (LSIC) order of conditions to June 6, 2019 after a heated compliance dispute.
minutes.summary: The Commission dismissed the Hickory Hills enforcement order and ruled on several hearings: dock stairs, a 5 Electric Ave addition, a Kilburn Street bridge, solar at 190 Electric Ave and a house at 150 Cross Road. Most time went to the draft Lake Shirley order of conditions and a short extension, where members split over the association's compliance. Hollis Road planning, minutes, trust funds and regulation updates were also covered.

what_happened.line: The Commission extended the Lake Shirley Improvement Corporation order of conditions until June 6, 2019, after members split over the association's compliance.
The Commission dismissed the Hickory Hills enforcement order at this time.
Orders of conditions passed for the 5 Electric Avenue addition, the Kilburn Street road and bridge deck repair, 190 Electric Avenue solar, and a house at 150 Cross Road.
A negative determination passed for the 205 Sunset Lane dock stairs, with stairs in after April 1 and out by October 15.
A site walk was set for Saturday, March 30 at 63 Prospect Street to review trees removed in the 50-foot zone.

why_it_matters: The short Lake Shirley extension keeps the permit conditions in force while a full order is drafted, which touches lake management and shoreline rules for abutters and association members.
Each permit extension carries a registry recording fee, so repeated short extensions add small recurring costs to the town's conservation work.
watch_next: A clean copy of the draft Lake Shirley order of conditions is to be circulated for review at the April 3 meeting.
A Hollis Road draft plan presentation is planned for the April 17 meeting.

Our minutes record a Hickory Hills enforcement dismissal and several budget figures (GIS, registry fee, trust funds) that the official minutes do not, while the official minutes have the 141 Hemlock enforcement closing and the Pleasant Street case that ours lack.
